title: nrf_fuel_gauge mid helpers: 439ce0, 43bb14, 43bc84, 43be18
approach: Bottom-up continuation. Idiomatic scalar-float C vs typographic stock on Renode 1.17 Cortex-M55, normal AAPCS, no fg_call. VFP helpers (vsub/vadd/vmul/vdiv/vfma/vfms/vabs/vcvt) keep typographic operand order so NaN payloads propagate. 43bc84/43be18 delayed-vmrs CFG: the 0x30 blt is N!=V (true LT or unordered), so a NaN query takes path 0x15e and the 0x16e bpl selects a constant +0 result. 43be18 is the same interpolator with the two y-tables swapped. 43bb14 count>=4 is a typographic frame overlap and was not compared. 439ce0 bit7/0x3fc smash path was not exercised.

verified.notes: 201-point table interpolator, r1=yA (scaled by k), r2=yB. Interior uses 43a5a0 floor plus wrapped vcvt indices; low/high ends extrapolate with dx=x[1]-x[0]. NaN query returns +0.

Max-abs one-hot: dst[i]=scale/src[i] at the winning index, others 0, unless |sel|*count*0x35A00000 >= |sel| (zero/Inf) which zeros dst. count==1 is the single-element path; count<=0 writes out={1,count} and does not touch dst. Counts tested: -1,0,1,2,3 (count>=4 overlaps typographic stack).

Clamp t into the 3-point x window (439e9c/439efc/439f24/439f88), then gather y samples at equal knots or two-channel interpolate via 439fe4. count==3 copies 6 packed y words; other small counts use the typographic split layout.
